thread:
sasha: FYI customers in eu-west reporting Dedicated Capacity shows 0 GPUs after last night's infra rollout. console dashboard empty for several clusters.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: infra/cluster-rollforward eu-west @ 2025-12-02T03:11:12Z :rocket:

taylor: getting the same in the console. billing/usage graphs still show token usage but gpu inventory panel is blank.
nora: I can `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and `nvidia-smi` on host — GPUs present and pods scheduled. UI aggregate is 0.
sasha: support ticket INC-2025-8019 opened. Customer impact: Dedicated customers seeing capacity mismatch and unable to scale.
samir: quick probe: inventory index shows nodes but gpu_count is 0 for many entries. Looks like telemetry join failed. Running a sample query now.

nora: curl snippet:
```
curl -s "https://inventory.internal.redwood/v1/clusters/eu-west/nodes" | jq '.nodes[] | {name:.name, host:.host, serial:.serial, gpu_count:.gpu_count, labels:.labels}'
```

samir: sample output (trimmed):
```
{ "name": "ded-gpu-07", "host": "node-07.eu-west.internal", "serial": "", "gpu_count": 0, "labels": {"pool":"dedicated-gpu","env":"prod"}}
{ "name": "ded-gpu-08", "host": "node-08.eu-west.internal", "serial": "S/N-OLD-4b2a", "gpu_count": 0, "labels": {"pool":"dedicated-gpu"}}
```

taylor: interesting — blank serial or changed serials. We pushed a firmware/agent update during rolling upgrade last night that can regenerate host serials. Indexer join is serial-first so it would lose the telemetry mapping.
sasha: that matches timeline with the deploy-bot entry.

samir: mitigation idea: run reconcile with fallback to hostname/mac if serial missing/mismatched. I tested dry-run: `./bin/inventoryctl reconcile --cluster eu-west --match-on hostname --dry-run` shows expected joins.

nora: commands used to reindex:
```
./bin/inventoryctl reconcile --cluster eu-west --match-on hostname --dry-run
# inspect diffs
./bin/inventoryctl reconcile --cluster eu-west --match-on hostname
```

support-agent: notified affected customers, added timestamps, and asked for ETA. Provided repro steps to support team.

taylor: there's a PR that introduces hostname fallback if serial mismatch: https://github.com/redwood/inventory/pull/834. Left one comment about cache invalidation. Will run CI and then hotfix rollout.
sasha: rollout plan:
- merge hotfix to inventory indexer (fallback join)
- run reconcile for impacted clusters (eu-west first)
- monitor integrity alerts and customer dashboards
- follow up with postmortem + long-term fix (multi-key join: serial+hostname+mac)

samir: after reconcile completed: UI inventory panel repopulated, gpu counts restored. Notifying customers now.
nora: added a temporary metric in console to alert if aggregated_gpu_count deviates >20% from node-level detection for >5m.
sasha: root cause notes for postmortem: firmware/agent update altered hardware serials; single-key join on serial caused telemetry loss; fix: reconcile + code change for multi-key stitching + alerting.
support-agent: ticket updated with mitigation and timeline, marking incident resolved for now.
sasha: thanks all. Keeping thread open to attach the full postmortem doc and timelines. :thumbsup:
